## Use GeoCase in your tests

```bash
pip install "geocase[all]"
```

[View GeoCase on PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/geocase/).

## What this case checks

Confirm GeoCase recognises a tiled, overview-bearing multispectral GeoTIFF as COG-structured while preserving band order and NoData.

## Risk types covered

- [`band/loss`](../risk/band-loss.md)
- [`format/not_tiled`](../risk/format-not-tiled.md)
- [`format/overviews_missing`](../risk/format-overviews-missing.md)
- [`nodata/ignored`](../risk/nodata-ignored.md)

## Expected behavior

| Assertion | Expected |
|---|---|
| `expect_loadable` | yes |
| `expect_crs` | yes |
| `expected_epsg` | `32633` |
| `expect_nodata` | yes |
| `expected_band_count` | `4` |
| `expected_dtype` | `uint16` |
| `expected_shape` | `[64, 64]` |
| `expected_nodata_value` | `0` |
| `nodata_convention` | `sentinel` |
| `expected_compression` | `deflate` |
| `expected_overviews` | yes |
| `expected_band_names` | `blue`, `green`, `red`, `nir` |
| `is_cog` | yes |
